text:
Ana (AM): New RFP from 'Continental Bank' - strict EU geofence POC requested. Key asks: EU-only compute+storage, BYOK in EU, telemetry never leaves EU, 24mo audit retention, list of subprocessors + SCCs. Need handoff for presales today.
Diego (SE): Quick Q - do they accept eu-wide control plane or require an EU-only control plane?
Ana (AM): They explicitly want EU-only control plane and no metadata replication to non-EU regions.
Max (infra): We can provision EU-only control plane for POC (dedicated control plane in eu-west-1). BYOK: customer KMS import requires Dedicated/Private; Hosted can use our EU KMS but keys stay in our tenancy.
Diego (SE): I'll prepare a short config snippet for the customer and a curl example for SE testing. Sample routing payload to include in docs:
```json
{"routing_mode":"pin","primary":"eu-west-1","failover":["eu-central-1"],"egress_policy":"eu-only"}
```
Max (infra): Subprocessors: EU compute/storage on AWS/GCP/Azure EU regions. Third-party monitoring default points to a US vendor; we can disable and route metrics to EU-only backend for this POC. Will open ops ticket.
GeoBot: Created ticket #7812 "continentalbank-eu-poc" assigned to Max. ETA 48h.
Claire (legal): Send me the subprocessors export snapshot, current DPA, and the SCCs we rely on. If they need 24mo audit retention note: standard hosted retention is 12mo; we can propose 24mo as a contractual addendum with EU storage.
Ana (AM): Ballpark pricing for RFP row: 2-week POC + 1mo reserved burst = ~USD 16k (Hosted with EU-only telemetry). Dedicated small pool / BYOK import bump = +USD 11k/mo. Caveat: final depends on token volume and perf tests.
Diego (SE): I'll upload the one-pager (routing, KMS options, subprocessors link, peering checklist, price sketch) to Drive and attach sample curl.
Max (infra): If they want VPC peering we need CIDR ranges & peering contact. Also confirm whether they want cross-region DB replicas within EU only (that affects egress).
Ana (AM): I'll collect SIG and CIDRs from buyer and loop Claire. Target to send RFP response today EOD.
Claire (legal): Will review SIG and flag any DPA exceptions.
Ana (AM): Thanks team :pray:
Diego (SE): +1 :thumbsup:
